title: Dimensions Convention (dimensions:)
description: Schema for dimensions information in Zarr. Properties use the 'dimensions:' namespace prefix.

attributes.description: Zarr attributes containing convention metadata and dimensions: prefixed properties

conventionMetadata.description: Dimensions convention metadata object for use in zarr_conventions array

schema_url.description: URL to the JSON Schema definition for this convention

spec_url.description: URL to the full specification document

uuid.description: UUID that permanently identifies this convention

description.const: Domain-agnostic mapping between a Zarr array's index space (axes) and coordinate space (coordinate encoding).
description.description: Brief description of the convention's purpose and usage

coordDescriptor.description: Coordinate encoding descriptor: how and where the values for an axis or coordinate are represented. Distinguished by 'type'.

oneOf.description: Explicit coordinate array. Points to a sibling Zarr array via a Zarr-relative path. Coordinate semantics (e.g. CF standard_name, units, axis) are not defined by this convention and MAY appear as additional properties; a future 'cf:' convention may formalize them.

path.description: Zarr-relative path to the coordinate array.

oneOf.description: Delegation to a named sibling convention that supplies or defines this coordinate. The canonical case is convention 'spatial', whose affine transform (spatial:transform, on the same node or an ancestor group) georeferences the axis — the GeoTIFF / GDAL model. The same mechanism covers temporal, vertical, spectral, lookup, or other future domain-specific conventions.

convention.description: Name of the sibling convention that supplies or defines this coordinate (e.g. 'spatial' for an affine geotransform).

oneOf.description: Inline coordinate values, embedded directly. Intended for short auxiliary axes (e.g. a small band/spectral axis) where allocating a separate Zarr array would be wasteful.

Implicit regularly spaced sequence. Equivalent to enumerating start, start+step, ..., end (end inclusive). Two value domains: numeric (start/end/step all JSON numbers) or ISO 8601 (start/end are date-time strings and step is an ISO 8601 duration like 'P1D').

start.description: First value of the sequence. Number for the numeric form; ISO 8601 date-time string for the temporal form.

end.description: Last value of the sequence (inclusive). Same JSON type as 'start'.

step.description: Increment between successive values. Number for the numeric form (non-zero; may be negative); ISO 8601 duration string for the temporal form (e.g. 'P1D', 'PT1H').

oneOf.description: ISO 8601 temporal interval. 'start' / 'end' are ISO 8601 date-time strings; 'step' is an ISO 8601 duration (starts with 'P').

axisObject.description: A dimension axis. Carries the axis semantics (what the axis represents) and, under 'coords', how the coordinate values for the axis are encoded. Keyed by a dimension name from the array's 'dimension_names'. Semantic fields for coordinate values (standard_name, calendar, etc.) are out of scope here and MAY ride along as additional properties for a future 'cf:' convention.

type.description: Axis kind. Recommended values follow the STAC datacube dimension types: 'spatial', 'temporal', 'geometry', or 'other'. Open string — domain-specific values are allowed.

axis.description: Spatial axis role, when applicable. Recommended values: 'x', 'y', 'z'.

unit.description: Unit of measurement for the coordinate values (e.g. a UCUM unit code or UDUNITS symbol).

coords.description: How the coordinate values for this axis are encoded and located. When omitted, the axis is an implicit integer index 0..n-1.

coordinateObject.description: An auxiliary or multi-dimensional coordinate (the CF auxiliary-coordinate model): a named coordinate that varies along one or more axes — e.g. lat(sample) for a point cloud, or lat(y,x) / lon(y,x) for a curvilinear grid. Keyed by the coordinate name (not a dimension name).

indexed_by.description: Dimension(s) this coordinate varies along. Each entry MUST be a dimension name from the array's 'dimension_names'. e.g. ['sample'] for a point-cloud coordinate lat(sample), or ['y','x'] for a curvilinear coordinate lat(y,x).

type.description: Coordinate kind. Same meaning as the axis 'type' field.

unit.description: Unit of measurement for the coordinate values (e.g. a UCUM unit code or UDUNITS symbol).

coords.description: How the coordinate values are encoded and located.

dimensionsAttributes.description: Dimensions properties using the dimensions: key prefix

dimensions:axes.description: Map from a dimension name to an axis object. Each key MUST be a dimension name from the Zarr v3 'dimension_names' field of the same array (or the Zarr v2 / Xarray '_ARRAY_DIMENSIONS' attribute). The axis object supplies the axis semantics (type, axis role, unit) and, under 'coords', how the values for that dimension are encoded.

dimensions:coordinates.description: Optional map from a coordinate name to an auxiliary / multi-dimensional coordinate object (the CF auxiliary-coordinate model). Each entry declares the dimension(s) it varies along via 'indexed_by' and how its values are encoded via 'coords'. Covers point clouds (lat(sample)) and curvilinear / multi-dimensional grids (lat(y,x)).

dimensions:version.description: Major version of the dimensions convention this metadata was authored against.
